written: AI-written, 9 November 2026, AG review third pass: an adversarial verification of the 'checks' agent's changes (pass3-checks.json). I read every diff of its 14 paths, REPOSITORY.md whole, and each re-quote against its home. Runs were one test file at a time with python3 -B -m unittest (pytest is not installed), the read-only dossier checker, and navigation's validators and render_views in memory (nothing written). No make, render, gate, lake or build ran. The full suite was deliberately not run, so this is selected evidence, not a full pass.
